images.caption: Figure 1:Context folding with reusable task objects in long-horizon OSWorld2.0(Yuan et al., 2026).Top:In a slide-editing task, the working presentation and exported images carry completed editing progress, while remaining constraints and save verification stay explicit, reducing active context from 42.4K to 14.4K tokens (66.0%).Bottom:In a lab-report task, the working document carries completed edits, while unresolved calculations remain explicit, reducing active context from 58.4K to 23.5K tokens (59.7%).

Figure 2:Overview of the CarryOn framework.CarryOn maintains an object-oriented context view comprising continuation carriers, execution context, and a live tail. When invoked, it tracks reusable progress, binds supporting evidence, checks relevant environment conditions, and jointly compiles carrier and execution-context updates. A successful fold commits validated updates and retires covered live-tail interactions from active context, while interaction log remains append-only.
